# Password input

**Status:** Stable  
**Reviewed against:** GOV.UK Frontend 6.5.0 on 2026-09-09

Use the Password input when users need to enter a password, with an optional progressively enhanced control to show or hide it.

## When to use

- Use for a password used to create or access an account.
- Use the show or hide control when seeing the entered value helps users prevent mistakes.

## When not to use

- Do not use for a one-time security code, memorable answer or other value that is not a password.
- Do not prevent password managers or pasting into the field.

## Anatomy

- **Label (required):** A visible label is explicitly associated with the password field.
- **Password field (required):** A type=password input uses suitable autocomplete, spelling and capitalisation attributes.
- **Show or hide toggle:** A hidden-by-default button is revealed by GOV.UK JavaScript and controls the input.
- **Hint and error:** Instructions and validation feedback are referenced with aria-describedby.

## Variants

| Variant | Element | Classes | Use |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Default | `input` | `govuk-input`, `govuk-password-input__input`, `govuk-js-password-input-input` | A current or newly created password. |
| Error | `input` | `govuk-input`, `govuk-input--error`, `govuk-password-input__input` | A password field whose submitted value did not meet the stated requirement. |

## Behaviour and progressive enhancement

- Initialise the govuk-password-input module to reveal the toggle and switch the field type between password and text.
- The toggle updates its visible label and accessible name between show and hide states.
- Without JavaScript, the password field remains usable and the hidden toggle stays hidden.

## Accessibility contract

- Use autocomplete=current-password for sign-in and autocomplete=new-password when creating or changing a password.
- Keep the field label visible and associate hint or error ids through aria-describedby.
- Allow browsers and assistive software to reveal, paste and fill passwords.

## Content rules

- State password requirements before the field and describe only rules the service actually enforces.
- Use “Show” and “Hide” toggle labels with accessible names that include “password”.
- Error messages should identify the unmet requirement without reproducing the password.

## Token references

- `govuk.color.input-border`
- `govuk.color.focus`
- `govuk.color.error`
- `govuk.spacing.static.2`

## HTML examples

### Current password

```html
<div class="govuk-form-group govuk-password-input" data-module="govuk-password-input">
  <label class="govuk-label" for="password">Password</label>
  <div class="govuk-input__wrapper govuk-password-input__wrapper">
    <input class="govuk-input govuk-password-input__input govuk-js-password-input-input" id="password" name="password" type="password" spellcheck="false" autocomplete="current-password" autocapitalize="none">
    <button type="button" class="govuk-button govuk-button--secondary govuk-password-input__toggle govuk-js-password-input-toggle" data-module="govuk-button" aria-controls="password" aria-label="Show password" hidden>Show</button>
  </div>
</div>
```
